name: Snapshot
description: A camera flash freezes the first clip into a printed photo with a white border, which shrinks, tilts and drops out of the frame, revealing the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tilt
params.description: How much the photo turns as it drops

params.name: border
params.description: Width of the photo's border, relative to the frame height

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the soft shadow the photo casts on the second clip
